A '''Fuel Jet''' was a component of a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projector]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] wrist guard mounted flame projector incorporated a Fuel Jet connected to a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] line, which in turn wrapped around an extended [[Heating Nozzle]]. The Fuel Jet expelled fuel which was subsequently set alight by the Heating Nozzle.<ref name="EGWT" />
